title: Paramount makes concessions to salvage $111 billion Warner Bros. Discovery deal
summary: Paramount's owners have made concessions to 12 Democratic state attorneys general to settle a lawsuit that endangered the media company's bid for its larger Hollywood rival, Warner Bros. Discovery.
contentText:
Paramount's owners have made concessions to 12 Democratic state attorneys general to settle a lawsuit that endangered the media company's bid for its larger Hollywood rival, Warner Bros. Discovery.

(Image credit: Noam Galai/Getty Images for Paramount)
